# PSA: New 1.15 build removes Range Checking from addons (e.g. DBM /range)
The latest 1.15 build has heavily modified the Range Checking API for the game, in-line with the change back in November on Retail.
This means that you can no longer type `/range` with DBM inside instances.
Some testing we did:
* DBM `/range` check disabled inside instances
* WeakAura built in range functionality works in instances until you enter combat then it breaks

...

**This change is for all of Classic Era, not just SoD.**
Personally I am pretty disappointed with this change. We were raiding AQ40 on Hardcore tonight then attempting KT this weekend, but having `/range` removed is a huge increase in difficulty.
I can see these changes making sense in Retail but I really don't think anyone was asking for this in Classic. I am not looking forward to C'thun Eye Beams tonight without a `/range` .
This brings up possible accessibility issues too. In retail boss mechanics are telegraphed with big brightly colored shapes and sounds, that isn't the case in Classic.
